entities.summary: Kevin Mark Boothe is an American former professional football player who was an offensive tackle in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Cornell Big Red. He was selected in the sixth round by the Oakland Raiders in the 2006 NFL draft. He also played for the New York Giants, winning two Super Bowls with the team, both against the New England Patriots.
